checks.label: Each solenoid brings in the box beside it, and with both off the springs bring the middle box back
The left box joins P to A and B to T, so the rod comes out; the right box joins P to B and A to T, so it goes back in
With the supply connected to the piston side and the rod side exhausted, the pressure on the piston side advances the rod
Closed holds the rod and sends the oil over the relief valve; P to T holds it and unloads the pump; Float blocks P and lets the load push the rod in
With -Y1 on, the rod is coming out within a second; at the end of its travel the oil goes over the relief valve with -Y1 still on
Leaks off, a held rod stays exactly where it stopped; Leaks on, it creeps back in below its mark, and in time all the way
A 4-way, two-position valve has 4 pipe connections, pressure, return, A and B, and two switched positions: the screen 2 valve has ports P, T, A and B on two boxes
Each symbol is drawn in its normal or neutral condition: at rest the main valve shows its middle box against the ports, and the 3/2 and the screen 2 valve the box beside their spring
Worked by hand: the screen 2 valve has 2 positions (slips 4 and 1), and the 5/2 has 1 + 2 + 2 = 5 ports (slips 2, 3 and 4); the typed fields ask exactly these
Before an answer nothing gives it away: puzzles open with no switches, rings or numbers; on screen 4 the row has not moved and its lines are idle, and on screen 10 Leaks is off
Every demonstration settles within 4.5 s, and every answer's motion within 3 s, except the creep on screen 10, which runs until the rod is fully in
